what: a cylinder (r 35, h 10) intersected with a conical loft (r 45 at z = -1 to r 33 at z = 11) that crosses its wall 1 mm below the top face (body came back unchanged)
method: the cone radius is 44 - z, so it meets the wall r = 35 at z = 9 and has r = 34 at the top: the result is the cylinder to z = 9 plus a frustum from r 35 to r 34 over 1 mm: V = pi 35^2 9 + pi/3 (35^2 + 35 34 + 34^2); faces: wall, cone, top, bottom.
